FOV delta function (charge up)
fields.definition: Use this curve to define how the FOV is modified while the character is charging up ground pound. The x axis measures time from the beginning of the charge up to the min charge up time. Y axis is the amount (in degrees) that the FOV is modified at the given time. Remember that you want a negative number to shrink the FOV.
